# DeskMakeover (桌面美颜)

> DeskMakeover is a free, open-source (MIT) Windows desktop beautifier built with Tauri 2 and Rust. It restyles every desktop icon with one of nine hand-tuned looks, lets you draw translucent organizer zones on your wallpaper, and can swap or remove the shortcut arrow. It backs up the desktop before any change, so one click restores the exact original. It runs entirely locally: no account, no telemetry, no uploads.

Supported: Windows 10 (1809+) and Windows 11, 64-bit. Not available for macOS or Linux.
Status: beta; the first installer ships via GitHub Releases.

## Links

- [English site](https://dm.nicepkg.cn/): product overview, nine preset gallery, FAQ
- [中文站点](https://dm.nicepkg.cn/zh/): 产品介绍、九套外观、常见问题
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/nicepkg/deskmakeover): source code, issues, releases
- [Downloads](https://github.com/nicepkg/deskmakeover/releases): installers and release notes

## Key facts

- One-click apply and one-click exact restore (snapshot-based; reversibility is an architectural constraint)
- Nine built-in icon looks: Squircle, Blueprint, Pixel Era, Gleam, Glaze, Die-Cut, Porthole, Scrapbook, Creekstone
- Eleven icon shapes plus independent coloring, plates, finishes, and shortcut marks
- Wallpaper zones: five materials, four title styles, ready-made layout templates
- Free forever, MIT licensed, local-only
